the.definition: Used before a noun to show that the person or thing is already known.
the.example: The quiet room made each sentence feel clear.

a.definition: Used before a singular noun when referring to something for the first time.
a.example: She found a narrow path through the fence.

this.definition: Used to refer to a person, thing, or idea that is near or has just been mentioned.
this.example: This sentence helped her understand the story.

that.definition: Used to refer to a person, thing, or idea that is farther away or already mentioned.
that.example: She did not know what the garden would reveal, only that it felt quiet.

it.definition: Used to refer to a thing, animal, situation, or idea already mentioned.
it.example: It helped her plan to return at dawn.

she.definition: Used to refer to a female person or animal already mentioned.
she.example: She had planned to read for only ten minutes.

he.definition: Used to refer to a male person or animal already mentioned.

read.definition: To look at and understand written words.
read.example: She had planned to read for only ten minutes.

make.definition: To create something or cause something to happen.
make.example: The quiet room made each sentence feel clear.

see.definition: To notice someone or something with your eyes, or to understand something.
see.example: Clara could see a narrow path through the fence.

know.definition: To have information or understanding about something.
know.example: She did not know what the garden would reveal.

feel.definition: To experience an emotion or physical sensation.

clear.definition: Easy to understand, see, or hear.

old.definition: Having lived for a long time or existed for a long time.
old.example: Clara arrived at the old observatory.

small.definition: Not large in size, amount, or degree.
small.example: The garden would reveal a small secret.

word.definition: A single unit of language that has meaning.
word.example: She clicked a word to see its meaning.

chapter.definition: A main section of a book.
chapter.example: The chapter was called The Window of Light.

story.definition: A description of real or imagined events.
story.example: The story helped her notice quiet details.

reader.example: A careful reader notices repeated patterns.

curious.definition: Wanting to know or learn something.

notice.example: She noticed a narrow path through the fence.

pattern.definition: A repeated or regular way in which something happens.
pattern.example: The pattern appeared again in the next sentence.

garden.definition: A piece of land used for growing flowers or plants.
garden.example: The garden gate had been locked for years.

gate.definition: A movable barrier used to close an opening in a wall or fence.
gate.example: The gate opened slowly at dawn.

lock.definition: To fasten something with a lock.
lock.example: The garden gate had been locked for years.

narrow.example: Clara could see a narrow path through the fence.

path.example: A narrow path ran through the garden.

fence.definition: A structure that separates or encloses an area.

observatory.definition: A building used for watching stars, planets, and other objects in space.
observatory.example: Clara arrived at the old observatory before dawn.

sentence.definition: A group of words that expresses a complete thought.

each.definition: Every one of two or more people or things, considered separately.

plan.definition: An idea or arrangement for doing something.
plan.example: She had planned to read for only ten minutes.

quiet.example: The quiet room made each sentence clear.

reveal.definition: To show something that was hidden or unknown.
reveal.example: The garden would reveal a small secret.

copy.definition: To make something that is the same as another thing.
copy.example: She copied the sentence into her notebook.

dawn.definition: The time in the morning when light first appears.
dawn.example: She planned to return at dawn.
